answer: Task-deposit rule: every new wallet must lock 25 POA for 12 epochs before it can grade or claim rewards, and the lock grows 20% for each extra wallet traced to the same funding address. A farmer wanting 1,000 fakes locks over 25,000 POA, rising far higher with each clone. Auditors sample 5% of wallets each epoch and slash idle ones. Honest agents that wander in pay once and recover the deposit, so a lone garden of real workers stays cheap while an oasis of fakes does not.
